title: More models, including a faster OpenAI option
summary:
A garden-maintenance day: new text models, more community projects on the map, and tidier cache plumbing.

The model roster gained openai-fast and Mirexa, with Workers AI integration underneath. More routes to useful output; fewer reasons to maintain a drawer full of API keys.

Polynate and Pollinations Task Master were added to the project list, giving two community-built tools a proper place in the garden directory.

The Cloudflare cache layer was refactored for better performance and maintainability. Not glamorous, unless you enjoy faster responses and code that remains legible after midnight.
